settings.memory.intro_hint: The model writes them on its own judgment, without being asked. Fix or delete anything you do not want it to remember. It is told not to write secrets such as passwords, but delete any you find.

startup.app_dir_unusable: SCITL couldn't write to the folder for its data. Check that the device has enough free storage, then start it again.
startup.database: SCITL couldn't read its data. The data may have been used by a newer version of SCITL, or its files may be damaged. If a newer version used it, start that version instead.
startup.no_app_dir: SCITL stopped because the OS didn't give it a place to keep its data or cache.
startup.no_executable: SCITL couldn't find where its executable is, so it couldn't decide where to keep its data.
startup.temporary_dir: SCITL stopped because its executable is in a temporary folder (for example, when started from inside an archive). Its data would be kept in the temporary folder and could be lost. Extract the archive and start the executable from a folder that isn't temporary.
startup.title: SCITL can't start
startup.unusable: SCITL couldn't write to the folder for its data. SCITL keeps its data in a folder named "data" next to its executable. Move the folder containing the executable to a place you can write to (such as under your user folder) and start it again.
task_chat.system_prompt: Through the conversation, ask what the user is trying to do, and help them make the task concrete and carry it out.
task_header.delete_dialog_message: This deletes "{title}" and hides its conversation.
turn_error.auth: The API key is missing or invalid, or lacks permission. Please check the API key in Settings.
turn_error.connection_failed: Could not communicate with the LLM provider. Please check that the server is running and your network connection.
turn_error.context_exceeded: The conversation may have exceeded the context limit. Setting this model's context length in the model list under "API Providers" in Settings lets old history be dropped automatically to reduce the token count.
turn_error.empty_response: The model returned an empty reply. Please try again.
turn_error.invalid_response: Could not interpret the reply from the LLM provider. Please check the server URL in Settings.
turn_error.key_unavailable: Nothing was sent to the LLM because the API key or a header value couldn't be read from the credential store. If the store is locked, unlock it and retry. If the key wasn't added on this device, add it again in Settings. See Settings for the reason.
turn_error.no_model: No model selected. Please select a model below the chat input.
turn_error.no_provider: No LLM provider is set up. Please add one in Settings.
turn_error.provider: The LLM provider returned an error.
turn_error.provider_config: There's a problem with the provider settings. Please check Settings.
turn_error.rate_limit: Hit the API rate limit. Please wait a while and try again.
turn_error.refused: The model declined to respond to this request. Rephrase it or try again with a different model.
turn_error.response_timeout: The LLM provider didn't reply in time. You can change how long to wait with the reply timeout under "General" in Settings.
turn_error.settings_unreadable: Could not read the settings file. Please check the details in Settings.
turn_error.thinking_effort_unsupported: This model didn't accept the selected thinking effort. Please pick a different thinking effort below the chat input.
turn_error.thinking_unsupported: This model didn't accept a thinking effort. Please uncheck "Think" for this model in the model list under "API Providers" in Settings.
turn_error.tool_round_limit: Reached the maximum number of tool calls, so the reply was cut short. You can change it under "Tools/MCP" in Settings.
turn_error.tool_timeout: Tools ran out of time, so the reply was cut short. You can change the limit under "Tools/MCP" in Settings.
